newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Feb construction orders fall 11.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Feb construction orders fall 11.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Orders received by 50 major Japanese construction companies fell 11.1 percent in February from a year earlier to 1.32 trillion yen, the Construction Ministry said on Monday.
In January, orders fell 6.3 percent year-on-year to 1.22 trillion yen.
